name: Maine Metal Designs, LLC
old_description: Welcome to Maine Metal Designs, a premier craft metal design and fabrication service located in central Maine, specializing in CNC plasma cutting.
about:
Maine Metal Designs, LLC operates from Turner, a town in central Maine. The company specializes in CNC plasma cutting and hand fabrication of metal components, offering a blend of automated precision and manual craftsmanship.

The shop produces fabricated parts, staircases, fire rings, and other custom metalwork using CNC plasma cutting combined with hand finishing. The process emphasizes custom, one-off or small-batch production tailored to individual project requirements.

The company serves customers seeking custom metal fabrication for architectural, decorative, and functional applications. Examples from its portfolio include staircases and fire rings, indicating a focus on residential and light commercial projects.

The business highlights its combination of CNC precision and hand craftsmanship as a distinguishing approach, positioning itself as a craft metal design and fabrication service rather than a high-volume production facility.
